title: Field Trip Permission Checklist
subtitle: Plan the trip, document transport and supervision, and route the guardian permission decision.
description: Captures the student and guardian, trip schedule, meeting and pickup locations, transportation, activities, supervision, emergency contact, support needs, permission scope, and return handoff.
use_case: Use when school or program staff request guardian permission for a specific trip. A material change to the itinerary, transport, supervision, or return plan requires renewed communication and review. For day-of-trip use, reconcile the live roster, departure and return schedule, transport handoffs, and authorized return. Preserve the vehicle or bus assignment, driver contact, boarding count, destination arrival, return transfer, and any in-flight trip-plan change.

sections.title: Field Trip Permission starting details review
sections.guidance: Name the student, guardian, destination, trip date, itinerary, transportation legs, chaperone group, emergency contact, permission choice, and return plan.

blocks.label: Field Trip Permission people and reference

sections.title: Field Trip Permission checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current field trip permission facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Field Trip Permission required checks
items: Destination is identified for this record
Itinerary matches the current request or source
Transport leg is ready for point-of-use staff
Headcount limits or questions are resolved
Chaperone group is communicated to the responsible person
Authorized return is confirmed at handoff
A changed field trip permission fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Field Trip Permission failed or pending items

sections.title: Field Trip Permission decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold field trip permission readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Field Trip Permission reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Field Trip Permission receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
